newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice fails to trade with funds elsewhere.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice fails to trade with funds elsewhere.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures did not trade on Monday because investors have moved their money into more active markets as a result of a negative views on the future of the market, traders said.
"The active stock market has attracted many retail investors and most of them have taken their money out of the rice market," one trader said.
Some traders said retail investors had lost interest in rice futures trading due to a lack of market-moving news and domination of the market by institutions.
"Retail investors don't want to build positions despite low futures prices because they are afraid of institutions dominating the market," a second trader said.
The price of spot rice is about 2,400 yuan per tonne while the October futures ended at 2,085 yuan last Friday.
